purpose: Define the first-page conceptual figure for RMD without implying complete bilateral accounting coverage, validated causal links, active feedback loops or behavioural closure.

adopted_rules: a structure image communicates only a comprehensible piece of the model
do not treat the diagram as full model documentation
distinguish sourced/modelled causal content from intuition
provide light/dark image variants with picture/prefers-color-scheme

visual_identity.style: monochrome, flat, no gradients, no shadows, no decorative illustration

information_hierarchy.label: RMD system boundary
information_hierarchy.semantic_rule: Sector labels identify the institutional boundary only. No inter-sector causal or bilateral-completeness arrows are shown.

information_hierarchy.label: Accounting Spine
information_hierarchy.semantic_rule: Accounting constraints are visually primary because they are hard constraints.

information_hierarchy.label: Observed evidence & reference modes
information_hierarchy.semantic_rule: Evidence informs the model but does not by itself activate behavioural structure.

information_hierarchy.label: Candidate dynamics
information_hierarchy.semantic_rule: Candidate status and inactivity must be explicit in the figure.

information_hierarchy.label: Activation gates
information_hierarchy.semantic_rule: Dynamic activation is conditional and downstream of explicit gates.

information_hierarchy.label: Current state
information_hierarchy.semantic_rule: Current state is a status footer, not a visual claim of completeness.

prohibited: arrows implying complete bilateral source coverage
arrows implying candidate feedbacks are active

public_readme_boundary.next_step: Render/review the preview inside .github/RMD_README_PREVIEW.md. Promote assets to assets/readme and replace the public README only after visual/editorial approval.
